scope: Post-training structural verification of the BWM action-adapter smoke checkpoint
summary: The saved checkpoint is a readable, finite action-encoder-only safetensors artifact; the training-path result remains WORKING and the campaign remains PARTIAL.
evidence: The checkpoint contains exactly 12 pipe.action_encoder tensors and no DiT tensors.
Those tensors contain 99637248 parameters with zero non-finite values.
The file is 199275904 bytes with SHA-256 30d6000a6a29ec401367f9a839aef7359f262fd79265dec4e08bfbac618631ec.
lessons: A successful process exit should be followed by structural checkpoint inspection before accepting a training smoke result.
limitations: Structural validity is not evidence of improved prediction quality, baseline superiority, SOTA, or real-robot performance.
next_actions: Run matched-seed balanced training and frozen comparisons before any model-quality promotion.
